questions.text: Do palpitations start and stop suddenly, fast and regular?

questions.lbl: Palpitations with fainting or chest pain
questions.text: Do palpitations come with fainting, chest pain or severe breathlessness?

questions.lbl: Heat intolerance, tremor, weight loss, or stimulant/caffeine use
questions.text: Heat intolerance, tremor, weight loss, or heavy caffeine/stimulant use?
Sweating, nausea, tunnel vision before fainting, triggered by pain, heat, standing or emotion?
Does it happen on standing up from lying or sitting?
Did the faint occur during exercise or exertion?
questions.why: Raises structural heart disease or arrhythmia.

questions.lbl: Family history of sudden death or early heart disease
questions.text: Anyone in the family died suddenly or young from a heart cause?

questions.lbl: Calf pain on walking relieved by rest
questions.text: Calf pain after walking a fixed distance that settles with rest?
Did the leg suddenly become painful, cold, pale or numb?
questions.why: Acute limb ischaemia is a limb-threatening emergency.

questions.lbl: Pain from back/buttock, eased by sitting or bending forward
questions.text: Is leg pain brought on by standing or walking and eased by sitting or bending forward?

questions.lbl: Frothy urine / puffy face in the morning
questions.text: Frothy urine or puffiness around the eyes in the morning?

questions.lbl: Heavy alcohol use, jaundice or abdominal swelling
questions.text: Heavy alcohol use, jaundice, or swollen abdomen?

diseases.name: Supraventricular tachycardia
diseases.inv: ECG during episode, Holter monitoring, thyroid function.
diseases.alt: Atrial fibrillation, anxiety, thyrotoxicosis, ventricular tachycardia

diseases.name: Atrial fibrillation
diseases.inv: ECG, thyroid function, echocardiography; stroke-risk assessment per guideline.

diseases.name: Dangerous ventricular arrhythmia / structural heart disease
diseases.inv: 12-lead ECG, echocardiography, Holter monitoring; urgent cardiology review.

diseases.name: Thyrotoxicosis or other non-cardiac cause of palpitations
Vasovagal (reflex) syncope
diseases.inv: Clinical; ECG to exclude cardiac cause.

diseases.name: Orthostatic hypotension
diseases.inv: Lying and standing BP, review medicines, hydration, glucose.
diseases.alt: Vasovagal syncope, dehydration, autonomic neuropathy, anaemia

diseases.name: Cardiac syncope (arrhythmia or structural disease)
diseases.inv: ECG, echocardiography, Holter; admit if high-risk features.

diseases.name: Peripheral arterial disease
diseases.alt: Spinal stenosis, venous disease, musculoskeletal pain

diseases.name: Acute limb ischaemia
diseases.inv: Emergency vascular assessment; Doppler; do not delay for imaging.
diseases.alt: Deep vein thrombosis, nerve compression, compartment syndrome

diseases.name: Lumbar spinal stenosis
diseases.inv: Clinical; MRI spine if persistent or neurological signs.

diseases.name: Deep vein thrombosis
diseases.inv: Clinical probability (Wells for DVT in its intended population), D-dimer, compression ultrasound.
diseases.tool: Wells DVT score applies to suspected DVT in ambulatory patients; limits apply.
diseases.alt: Cellulitis, ruptured Baker cyst, chronic venous disease

diseases.name: Nephrotic / nephritic syndrome (kidney cause of oedema)
diseases.inv: Urine routine and protein, serum creatinine and albumin, urine protein-creatinine ratio.
diseases.alt: Heart failure, liver disease, drug-induced oedema

diseases.name: Chronic liver disease / cirrhosis
diseases.inv: Liver function tests, albumin, INR, ultrasound abdomen.

flags.text: Sudden cold, pale, painful leg: limb-threatening ischaemia, urgent vascular assessment
Palpitations with fainting, chest pain or exertional faint: urgent ECG and cardiology review
Exertional faint or family history of sudden death: possible cardiac cause, needs ECG
